name: receipts
description: A personal Google Antigravity impact report for justifying your usage to a manager or a self-review: what you shipped, which projects it went to, and each project's share of your usage. Reads your ~/.gemini/config/projects transcripts and runs read-only git locally; only counts and project names are sent to write it up, and the report stays on your machine.
suggestedPrompts: Run diagnostics and inspect Receipts capabilities
Review configuration and settings for Receipts
